_readme: One entry per project, in site order. The 001, 002 index comes from this order.
category: Brand Film, Music Video, Social Campaign, Event, Branding or Wedding.
media lives in public/work/<folder>/: loop.mp4 + loop.webm (muted, under 3 MB), poster.jpg, still-N.jpg. All films are cropped to their picture, no black bars.
aspect is the shape of the cover: 2.39, 2, 16:9, 9:16, 4:5.
null fields are hidden on the site and listed as TODO. Nothing here is invented.

projects.title: Honda
projects.role: Production, edit and colour grade for the full campaign
projects.brief: Three brand films for Honda, each led by a creator: Dixita Karki, Salomee and Urgen Moktan. Everyday stories where the scooter is part of a life, not the hero of an ad.

projects.title: Pokhara Enduro Race
projects.role: Content direction, shoot, edit, grade, posting and promotion
projects.brief: A run of ad films for the Pokhara Enduro Race, made to open registration. The job was simple: tell enduro riders across Nepal and abroad that this race is happening, and make them want to ride it.

projects.title: SHUTDOWN
projects.brief: AYG's SHUTDOWN, produced by Niswon Music. A night-city music video with a noir edge, directed and cut by Sunya.

projects.title: See How We Shine
projects.brief: A commercial for Shishu Kalyan School. Classrooms, corridors and trophy shelves, cut around one idea: every child here gets the chance to shine.

projects.title: Chari Haru Sangai
projects.role: Concept, shoot, edit and grade, with freelancers and partner teams from Pokhara
projects.brief: A music video for Sagar Satyal. We led concept, shoot, edit and grade, and pulled in freelancers and partner teams from around Pokhara to build it: hair and make-up, a lakeside set and a night shoot.

projects.title: Ma Jati Ruyeni
projects.role: Direction, cinematography, production, artist and location management, colour grading
projects.brief: Prabin Gurung's Ma Jati Ruyeni, featuring Prabesh and Kushmina. Everything except the music was Sunya: casting and managing the artists, locations, production, direction, cinematography and the grade, all by our own team. We also designed the release poster for the 15 September premiere.

projects.title: Hulaki Band
projects.brief: Hulaki Band played Aashirwad Music Fest at Rolling Stone Lakeside, Pokhara, on 15 May. We ran the campaign around it, 36 pieces over 19 days, and closed it with the after-movie.

projects.title: Creators Summit Nepal 2026
projects.brief: Creators Summit Nepal brought creators and brands together in Kathmandu on 3 July 2026. We built the identity from Nepali patterns and a deep red, then carried it through the event design and reels.

projects.title: World Egg Day Nepal
projects.brief: A digital campaign for World Egg Day Nepal, running 25 September to 8 October under #EggForEveryChild, then coverage of the event in Chitwan on 9 October.

projects.title: Singapore Cafe
projects.role: Concept, direction, shoot, edit and grade
projects.brief: A brand film for Singapore Cafe in Nadipur, Pokhara: the room, the coffee bar and its barista workshop, and the evenings when the music starts.

projects.title: Star Education and Migration
projects.brief: Star Education and Migration helps students study abroad. Every month we shoot and cut their reels: country guides, visa updates and counsellors answering the questions students actually ask.

projects.title: New Light Secondary School
projects.brief: Admissions season for New Light Secondary School. Reels that put students in front of the camera, and key visuals for the +2 intake.

projects.title: Royal Wedding and Events
projects.brief: Royal Wedding and Events plans weddings and events in Pokhara. On a monthly retainer we make six reels and six posts a month, including founder-led videos we record together.

projects.title: Novus Group
projects.brief: Novus Group is an AI company in the USA. We edit four videos a month for them: two-speaker explainers in 4:5 with animated captions, punch-ins and graphic cards.

projects.title: Renu Events and Flower
projects.role: Brand identity, design and social media
projects.brief: Renu Events and Flower designs flowers and events in Pokhara. We built their identity and service catalogue, and run their social media every month.
